coach_bio.title: Coach, part-time puddle philosopher
coach_bio.intro: I am Coach Quill Puddlewick, a completely fictional coach for the equally fictional Modularity Mallards. We are here to have a grand time with a football, several cones, and only the minimum legally advisable amount of bewilderment.
coach_bio.day_job: Assistant Deputy Keeper of the Emergency Biscuit Tin. This position is fictional, but the responsibility is immense.
coach_bio.soccer_credentials: I once explained offside to a duck. The duck disagreed, but it was a thoughtful disagreement.
coach_bio.plan: Every Mallard gets plenty of ball contacts, a turn in every role, and a chance to make brave little decisions. We will play small-sided games, celebrate kindness, and treat mistakes as useful field research. The universe is vast; the next pass need not be.
coach_bio.sign_off: Waddle on, Mallards — and remember where you left the cones.
